text_en: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brothers and sisters, I do not want you to be uninformed.
text_cn: 弟兄们，至论神恩的事，我切愿你们明了。

text_en: You know that when you were pagans, you were enticed and led astray to idols that could not speak.
text_cn: 你们记得：当你们还是外教人的时候，好像着了迷，常被勾引到那些不会出声的偶像前。

text_en: Therefore I want you to understand that no one speaking by the Spirit of God ever says “Let Jesus be cursed! ” and no one can say “Jesus is Lord” except by the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 为此，我告诉你们，没有一个受天主圣神感动的会说：“耶稣是可诅咒的；”除非受圣神感动，也没有一个能说：“耶稣是主”的。

text_en: Now there are varieties of gifts, but the same Spirit;
text_cn: 神恩虽有区别，却是同一的圣神所赐；

text_en: and there are varieties of services, but the same Lord;
text_cn: 职分虽有区别，却是同一的主所赐；

text_en: and there are varieties of activities, but it is the same God who activates all of them in everyone.
text_cn: 功效虽有区别，却是同一的天主，在一切人身上行一切事。

text_en: To each is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the common good.
text_cn: 圣神显示在每人身上虽不同，但全是为人的好处。

text_en: To one is given through the Spirit the utterance of wisdom, and to another the utterance of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
text_cn: 这人从圣神蒙受了智慧的言语，另一人却由同一圣神蒙受了知识的言语；

text_en: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by the one Spirit,
text_cn: 有人在同一圣神内蒙受了信心，另有人在同一圣神内却蒙受了治病的奇恩；

text_en: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another the discernment of spirits, to another various kinds of tongues, to another the interpretation of tongues.
text_cn: 有的能行奇迹，有的能说先知话，有的能辨别神恩，有的能说各种语言，有的能解释语言：

text_en: All these are activated by one and the same Spirit, who allots to each one individually just as the Spirit chooses.
text_cn: 可是，这一切都是这唯一而同一的圣神所行的，随他的心愿，个别分配与人。

text_en: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ.
text_cn: 就如身体只是一个，却有许多肢体；身体所有的肢体虽多，仍是一个身体：基督也是这样。

text_en: For in the one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—Jews or Greeks, slaves or free—and we were all made to drink of one Spirit.
text_cn: 因为我们众人，不论是犹太人，或是希腊人，或是为奴的，或是自主的，都因一个圣神受了洗，成为一个身体，又都为一个圣神所滋润。

text_en: Indeed, the body does not consist of one member but of many.
text_cn: 原来身体不只有一个肢体，而是有许多。

text_en: If the foot would say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body, ” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
text_cn: 如果脚说：“我既然不是手，便不属于身体；”它并不因此就不属于身体。

text_en: And if the ear would say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body, ” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
text_cn: 如果耳说：“我既然不是眼，便不属于身体；”它并不因此就不属于身体。

text_en: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole body were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?
text_cn: 若全身是眼，哪里有听觉？若全身是听觉，哪里有嗅觉？

text_en: But as it is, God arranged the members in the body, each one of them, as he chose.
text_cn: 但如今天主却按自己的意思，把肢体个个都安排在身体上了。

text_en: If all were a single member, where would the body be?
text_cn: 假使全都是一个肢体，哪里还算身体呢？

text_en: As it is, there are many members, yet one body.
text_cn: 但如今肢体虽多，身体却是一个。

text_en: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I have no need of you, ” nor again the head to the feet, “I have no need of you. ”
text_cn: 眼不能对手说：“我不需要你；”同样，头也不能对脚说：“我不需要你们。”

text_en: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
text_cn: 不但如此，而且那些似乎是身体上比较软弱的肢体，却更为重要；

text_en: and those members of the body that we think less honorable we clothe with greater honor, and our less respectable members are treated with greater respect;
text_cn: 并且那些我们以为是身体上比较欠尊贵的肢体，我们就越发加上尊贵的装饰，我们不端雅的肢体，就越发显得端雅。

text_en: whereas our more respectable members do not need this. But God has so arranged the body, giving the greater honor to the inferior member,
text_cn: 至于我们端雅的肢体，就无须装饰了。天主这样配置了身体，对那缺欠的，赐以加倍的尊贵，

text_en: that there may be no dissension within the body, but the members may have the same care for one another.
text_cn: 免得在身体内发生分裂，反使各肢体彼此互相关照。

text_en: If one member suffers, all suffer together with it; if one member is honored, all rejoice together with it.
text_cn: 若是一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体都一同受苦；若是一个肢体蒙受尊荣，所有的肢体都一同欢乐。

text_en: Now you are the body of Christ and individually members of it.
text_cn: 你们便是基督的身体，各自都是肢体。

text_en: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers; then deeds of power, then gifts of healing, forms of assistance, forms of leadership, various kinds of tongues.
text_cn: 天主在教会内所设立的：第一是宗徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行异能的，再次是有治病奇恩的、救助人的、治理人的、说各种语言的。

text_en: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
text_cn: 众人岂能都做宗徒？岂能都做先知？岂能都做教师？岂能都行异能？

text_en: Do all possess gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
text_cn: 岂能都有治病的奇恩？岂能都说各种语言？岂能都解释语言？

text_en: But strive for the greater gifts. And I will show you a still more excellent way.
text_cn: 你们该热切追求那更大的恩赐。我现在把一条更高超的道路指给你们。
